text: I have a CSV of monthly sales figures with inconsistent date formats. Help me write a Python snippet that normalises them all to ISO format.
My sourdough starter has gone flat and smells like acetone. Walk me through what's happening and how I bring it back.
Explain the difference between a mutual fund and an ETF to someone who has never invested before. Keep it to a few short paragraphs.
I'm writing a lab report on enzyme kinetics. Help me phrase the methods section so it reads clearly in the passive voice.
Our neighbourhood association needs an agenda for next Thursday's meeting. Topics are parking, the playground repair, and the budget. Draft it.
What's a reasonable weekly running plan for someone who has never run before and wants to finish a 5k in three months?
My laptop fan runs constantly even when nothing is open. Help me work out what's causing it before I take it in for repair.
Summarise the main arguments for and against a four-day working week. I want something balanced I can bring to a debate club.
I'm cooking for eight and one person is coeliac. Suggest a menu that doesn't feel like everyone else is eating a compromise.
Help me draft a short message to my landlord asking when the boiler inspection is scheduled. Polite, just needs to be clear.
Explain how compound interest works using a concrete example of someone saving two hundred pounds a month for twenty years.
I keep confusing 'affect' and 'effect' when I write. Give me a rule I can actually remember, with a few examples.
Plan a three-day itinerary for Lisbon for someone who cares about food and architecture and doesn't want to rush.
My tomato plants have yellowing lower leaves but the fruit looks fine. Talk me through the likely causes and what to check.
Help me write a clear one-paragraph description of my team's project for the company intranet. It's an internal tool for tracking invoices.
What's the actual difference between a virus and a bacterium, and why do antibiotics only work on one of them?
I'm learning guitar and my barre chords buzz constantly. Diagnose what I'm probably doing wrong and give me something to practise.
Draft a short thank-you note to the vet who looked after our dog last week. Warm but not gushing, four or five lines.
Explain to me how a bill actually becomes law in the UK, from first reading through to royal assent. Keep it concise.
I need to cite a podcast episode in APA format for a university essay. Show me the exact structure with a worked example.
Help me plan the shopping and prep so I can make three weeknight dinners on Sunday and not cook again until Thursday.
My Excel formula keeps returning a REF error after I deleted a column. Explain why and how I fix the references properly.
Give me a plain-English explanation of what a VPN actually does, and what it doesn't do, for someone who isn't technical.
I want to start reading philosophy properly. Suggest an order to read things in that won't leave me completely lost by book two.
Write a short listing for a secondhand bicycle. It's a blue steel tourer, twelve years old, new tyres, some rust on the chainstay.
Our book club is reading Middlemarch. Give me six discussion questions that will actually generate argument rather than plot summary.
Explain what happens physiologically during jet lag, and whether any of the standard advice about light exposure genuinely helps.
Help me set up a simple budget spreadsheet. I want fixed costs, variable costs, and a column showing what's left each month.
I'm repainting a room that currently has dark green walls. Talk me through the primer and coat sequence to get a clean off-white.
Give me a short history of how the standardised shipping container changed global trade. Two or three paragraphs, no jargon.
